note.question: How does yield uncertainty affect note on cournot competition?
note.overview: Inspired by the U.S. influenza vaccine market, we formulate a Cournot competition model with asymmetric firms facing capacity constraints and yield uncertainty. The paper derives the equilibrium of this model by defining a score that ranks firms based on their capacity, unit production cost, random yield mean, and variance. Firms that have scores above a threshold produce at full capacity, while other firms produce less than their capacities in the equilibrium.
